users.title: Iseqdacen
users.addHint: Amiḍan yettwarna. Ad d-iban useɣwen ara tbeṭṭuḍ akken amdan ad yesbadu awal-is uffir s yiman-is.
users.name: Isem ummid
users.missingKeyHint: I usefrek n imiḍanen, rnu tasarut SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY deg ufaylu .env.local (Supabase > Settings > API > service_role), syen ales asenker n uqeddac.
users.linkHint: Azen aseɣwen-a i umdan (WhatsApp, SMS…). Ad t-yeldi akken ad yefren awal uffir yerna ad yesremd amiḍan-is.

setPassword.tooShort: Awal uffir ilaq ad yesɛu ma drus 6 n yisekkilen.
setPassword.mismatch: Sin wawalen uffiren ur mṣadan ara.

schools.title: Tiɣermiwin
schools.addHint: Yesnulfu-d taɣiwant tamaynut s unebdad-nnes. Aseggas adelsan amiran d useɣwen n tinteɛ ttwaselgamen s wudem awurman.
schools.name: Isem n tɣermt
schools.slugHint: Ǧǧ-it d ilem akken ad d-yili s wudem awurman seg yisem. Neɣ: isekkilen imecṭuḥen, izwilen d yijerriden kan. Amedya: el-nour.
schools.addAdminHint: Yeskar anedbal amezwaru n tɣermt «{school}». Ad d-yban useɣwen n tinnubga ara tebḍuḍ.
schools.linkHint: Azen aseɣwen-a i unedbal amaynut. Ad t-yeldi akken ad yefren awal n uɛeddi-ines yerna ad yermed amiḍan-is.
schools.superAdminOnly: Anekcum i yijerriden i unedbal ameqqran n uɣawas kan.
schools.missingKeyHint: Akken ad tesferkeḍ tiɣermiwin, rnu tasarut SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY ɣer .env.local (Supabase > Settings > API > service_role), syen ales asenker n uqeddac.
schools.ERR_slugInvalid: Asulay arameɣtu: isekkilen imecṭuḥen, izwilen d yijerriden kan.
schools.rowHint: Ssit ɣef taɣiwant akken ad tt-tesferkeḍ (anebdad, asremed).
schools.editAdminHint: Beddel isem d imayl n unebdad.
schools.deleteConfirm: Kkes taɣiwant-a i lebda s yisefka-nnes akked yimiḍanen-nnes meṛṛa? Tigawt-a ur tettuɣal ara.
